# MLES policy templates

These three files are copied unchanged from the local official MLES checkout
pinned by the project adapter to commit
`acda6457adb30c6204884648496fb04115083fa1`:

`llm4ad/task/machine_learning/{acrobot,pendulum,moon_lander}/template.py`

Their original MIT license is preserved in [LICENSE](LICENSE). The REFLEX
wrappers append task-specific objectives. No MLES optimizer or Git history
is included here.
